title: One Save Everywhere
tagline: One game save follows me between old consoles, ports and emulators.
what: A service that keeps one game save moving between original console versions, PC ports, native rebuilds and different emulators, even when each one stores the same progress in a different format.
built: Wrote two-way converters between PlayStation memory cards and the PC saves for Final Fantasy VII and IX
Bridged Ocarina of Time, Pokémon and Switch saves between versions that store them differently
Backed up the old side, waited for files to settle and refused pairs that were not safe to convert
Parked stale emulator auto-saves before they could overwrite newer in-game progress
starring: My games, wherever I pick them up

making.problem: The same game can have a memory card, a PC file and an emulator file that cannot read one another. I wanted to stop choosing which version owned my progress.
how: Each game has a pair that names its two save formats and the safe direction between them
The watcher waits for a stable file, backs up the older side and converts only the game data both versions share
The new file moves through my save folder to the other devices
A status screen shows both sides together so I can see that the slot and time match

moment.what: A Final Fantasy IX save from the PC crossed to a PlayStation card in about 30 seconds, then loaded in the original game with the same place and play time.
